conviction_note: The Q2 print itself was pre-announced in all but name: the guide was set on 2026-06-16 with two weeks of the quarter left, and the last two guides were hit just above the top. So the number is priced. What moves the stock is the Q3 guide and the full-year target. A >100% FY2026 volume target needs about 67k units in H2. The Q2 guide is 18-19k and no seventh superstore has opened since 2026-03-31, so the target is out of reach. That is sized -2.5 on this name's rebuilt earnings-reaction scale (median absolute move 8.5%), plus -0.5 for the unfunded Prestige Shine commitment. The emitted -2.0 is 1.0 below the -3.0 sum because anyone could have done the arithmetic on 2026-06-16 (the stock fell -10.4% that day and ~-29% since), and the stock sits 6% above its 52-week low four sessions before the CEO's 10b5-1 buying can start.
bar: Company guidance for Q2 2026, given 2026-06-16: retail volume 18,000-19,000 units and total revenue RMB1,050-1,100M (midpoint RMB1,075M). Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001729173/000149315226028826/ex99-1.htm. There is no sell-side consensus in any source found (https://www.tradingkey.com/markets/stocks/uxin/forecast carries only the company guide), so the bar is the company's guide. Track record on near-completed quarters: Q1 2026 guided 16,200-16,500 units and RMB1,050-1,070M and printed 16,530 and RMB1,073.7M; Q4 2025 guided >18,500 and printed 19,160 (https://ir.xin.com/2026-04-10-Uxin-Reports-Unaudited-Financial-Results-for-the-Quarter-and-Full-Year-Ended-December-31,-2025). The expected print is the top of the range, about RMB1,090-1,100M, which is +1.5% against the midpoint.
positioning_check: FINRA short interest was 526,430 ADS at the 2026-08-31 settlement (+22,867), 9.30 days to cover, 0.2% of shares outstanding. The prior settlement, 2026-08-14, was 503,563 ADS at 1.19 days (https://equibles.com/stocks/uxin/short-interest, read 2026-09-23). Days to cover is high only because turnover is tiny (20-day average about 49.5k ADS, roughly $53k a day). As a share of stock it is not crowded, but the float is thin: Joy Capital entities hold ~26-31% per the 13D/A of 2026-05-15. No options market, so no skew and no priced direction. The tape: -5.7% over 20 days, -73% from the 52-week high, +6.4% above the 52-week low.

findings.finding: The FY2026 target of '>100% retail volume growth' cannot be reached with the network the company has. It was reaffirmed on 2026-06-16. FY2025 retail volume was 51,110 (Q1 7,545 + Q2 10,385 + Q3 14,020 + Q4 19,160), so the target needs >102,220 units. H1 comes to about 35,000 (Q1 16,530 plus a Q2 guide of 18-19k), which leaves ~67,000 for H2, or ~33.5k a quarter, against a Q2 run-rate of ~18.5k. The company's own press-release stream up to 2026-09-16 shows no superstore opened after Tianjin on 2026-03-31. Chongqing (2026-05-21), Shijiazhuang (JV, 2026-06-02) and Shaoxing (2026-07-20) are announced projects only. So the Q3 guide given on 09-24, with Q3 almost over, should land around +45-65% year on year, and the FY target has to be cut or dropped.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rebuilt from confirmed results releases (ir.xin.com/Quarterly-Results) with Yahoo daily closes: 2025-06-12 -8.5%, 2025-09-29 -0.9%, 2025-12-18 +11.0% (came with a financing agreement), 2026-04-10 -1.3%, 2026-06-16 -10.4%. On 2026-06-16 the quarter slightly beat its guide while the next-quarter guide fell from >110% to +73-83% year on year, with a margin warning. Guide deceleration is the line this stock sold hardest.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 guide had made the arithmetic possible since June, and the stock has fallen ~29% since (weekly close ~$1.51 after the Q1 print, $1.075 now). Some of this is probably priced, and that is why the size is below the name's 8.5% median earnings move. It is not fully priced because no sell-side number exists to reset. The company has not withdrawn the target, and the reaffirmation in the 06-23 FAQ and at the 06-25 investor day is still the last word. With no analyst to downgrade, the formal cut and the Q3 run-rate are only seen when the release prints. If the market had already priced the cut, a Q3 guide would not matter and the stock would not have sold -10.4% on the last deceleration.
findings.independence: Store count comes from a different source: the company's own news list, which shows no new superstore opening between 2026-03-31 and 2026-09-16 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/UXIN/). Chinese press confirms six operating stores: https://finance.sina.com.cn/tob/2026-03-31/doc-inhswpmu8906562.shtml. FY2025 base of 51,110: https://www.163.com/dy/article/KQ6FKIC80556BSAL.html. The volume figures all come from company releases, so the independent part is the store count.

findings.finding: Of the December 2025 US$50M share subscription at US$2.859 per ADS, Prestige Shine Group's US$30M still appears unfunded. The 2026-06-29 6-K closed only a US$15M NIO-designated tranche, and no closing 6-K has been filed since. The subscription price is now 2.66x the $1.075 spot. Cash was only RMB47.4M at 2026-03-31 against RMB745M of current liabilities. The money was earmarked for the four to six 2026 superstores, and none has opened. If the release updates that commitment, the likely forms are repricing, termination or a slip. Closing at $2.859 would be the positive surprise, and nothing observable points to it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-12-18: the Q3 2025 print came with 'entry into definitive agreement for financing' and the stock rose +11.0% on the day. 2026-06-29: the US$15M closing day moved -0.66% (baseline row). Financing news has moved this stock both ways.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, which is why the size is small. A stock at 38% of the subscription price implies the market already assumes Prestige Shine will not fund at $2.859. The release is simply the first place a status update can appear, and there has been no 6-K since 2026-07-01. Financing question asked and answered: the money buys superstores, and none has opened (see the first finding), so there is no ramp to corroborate. A going-concern paragraph was carried in the prior 20-F. That leans negative, but the sign of the in-window resolution is genuinely unknown, so the range spans zero.
findings.independence: The subscription terms are in the 2025-12-26 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1729173/000149315225029201/ex99-1.htm). The ~$40M 'signed but unfunded' figure is in the company FAQ (https://ir.xin.com/2026-06-23). This finding shares the store-count evidence with the first finding, but it lands on a different line (financing, not guidance).

outside_window.finding: The CEO-controlled Xin Gao Group's Rule 10b5-1 plan to buy up to US$5M of ADS at no more than US$2.85 starts 2026-09-28, after the 90-day cooling-off. At spot that is ~4.6M ADS, about 90 days of the stock's entire average volume. It is a known, dated buyer, but its first possible purchase comes after the 2026-09-24 exit close.

Industry Q3 used-car data (CADA July -5.98% and August -11.19% year on year; used-car manager index 41.3% in August) set against management's Q3 margin-recovery claim. Dropped as a finding: it is macro-to-company inference, and the condition management actually named, ICE new-car prices stabilising, is supported by CPCA's count of August price cuts (10 models against 23 a year earlier): https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260907A0D6IR00 ; https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260920A08TDG00
baseline_tension: The negative lean agrees with the run-up (-5.7% over 20 days, -29% since the last print, 6% above the 52-week low), so part of it is likely priced. There is no skew to fight. The baseline's 3.25% expected move comes from non-earnings 6-Ks. The rebuilt earnings median of 8.5% says the name moves more on prints than the baseline implies.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (a narrow proxy is a hypothesis) and lesson 3 (a finding that argues against itself): dropped the -1.0 industry-margin finding. The CADA and used-car-manager series are macro-to-company inference, and the condition the company named for Q3 margin recovery, stabilising ICE prices, is supported by CPCA's count of fewer price cuts. It moved to searched_and_found_nothing.

Lesson 8 plus the rule on untrustworthy history: rebuilt the base rate from five confirmed results releases (median absolute move 8.5% against the baseline's 3.25%). Resized the guidance finding from -2.0 to -2.5 and widened its range to -10/+3.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the Prestige Shine money buys. The answer is superstores, none of which has opened, and the prior 20-F carried going-concern language, so it leans negative. The in-window sign is still unknown, so it stays at -0.5 with a symmetric-ish range, left standing.

Lesson 3 (the caveat has to reach the number): the emitted move (-2.0) is 1.0 below the findings sum (-3.0) because the run-up and the post-June drawdown show part of the guide cut is priced. Lesson 5 says an unexplained drawdown is worth 0 as evidence, so the discount is kept modest.

Lesson 6: the bar is sourced to the company guide, and the Q2 print itself lands inside that guide, so no finding rests on the reported quarter. The CEO 10b5-1 start date (2026-09-28) stays in outside_window.
